title: Baade hussain zainab kya kya na bangayi
body:
Baad e hussain zainab kya kya na ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
1. Beemar ka bistar bhi jalaaya gaya logo, masoom sakina ko rulaaya gaya logo
Mazloom o yateemo ka ehsaas ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shabbier se jo bichdhi jeene nahi paayi, bhaayi ki wo surat ko bhulaane nahi paayi
Bhaayi se chutke zainab be aas ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sham e ghareeba’n me jab asbaab lut gaya, pehre pe lagi zainab sab kunba sogaya
Abbas ki behan ab abbas ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Abbas mar gaye to be aas sab huwe, cheeni gayi chaadar aur beparda sab huwe
Beparda bibiyon ki wo ek aas ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Daakhil huwi darbar me abbas ke bina, kursi nasheen takte hai sadma hai ye kitna
Darbar me pidar ka wo akkaas ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Chaadar chini aseer huwi bint e buturaab, durre sahe layeen ke paaya na khatr e aab
Zain e ali ghamo ka khirtaas ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aye
Meer
kaisi sakht qayamat ki thi ghadhi, misl e batool zer e shajar girya karti thi
Bint e rasool ka wo akkaas ban gayi, shah e najaf bani kabhi abbas ban gayi’n
Kalaam : Meer Kumai ALi
